prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A crowd seen from behind, faces turned away toward the crate, stands at the foot of a hill, several arms raised pointing up at a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, resting flat on the hilltop, the roof empty and flat, its wide wooden door open in the side and an earthen ramp down to the dust.
